Exercise: PRONE Y RAISE. Lie FACE DOWN on floor with chest/abdomen/pelvis and legs supported. Neck relaxed in line with spine, forehead just above floor and gaze down. Both arms extend diagonally OVERHEAD at45degrees from midline so body forms Y shape from above. Elbows straight, thumbs point UP, palms toward each other. Both entire arms/hands lifted only5-10cm above floor, shoulder blades draw gently down/back. Do NOT arch trunk high, no Superman leg lift. Legs remain long on floor. Camera elevated REAR-side three-quarter from foot end, clearly seeing back and separated Y arms, complete head/hands/feet. Coral only lower trapezius regions of mid-back and visible shoulder deltoids; arms grey, spine grey. No equipment.

review.notes: Prone torso and legs supported, arms extend overhead in Y with thumbs upward and slight floor clearance; no large lumbar arch/leg lift. Coral shoulder caps and lower medial back regions. Head turned slightly rather than forehead-down; neck still close to torso line.
